heading: Grade on entry upon active duty
lead: A Reserve officer ordered to active duty or active duty for training shall be ordered in the grade held; except that the Secretary may authorize a higher grade.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 776 of this title prior to the complete revision of former chapter 21 of this title by Pub. L. 96–322.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 745 of this title as this section.
